Portfolio

Since August of 2024, I’ve been studying at the ROC Media Studies of Hilversum as an AV specialist, specializing in Video Post-Production.

Over these years, I’ve had the chance to embrace my creativity and passion through various group and independent projects. Skills I learned and practiced include production (concept-to-delivery), directing, gaffing, audio recording and mixing, and much more.

In this section, you will find yourself browsing through some personally selected projects that I’ve been proud to be a part of.

Our first ever group project.

Nearly halfway into our first year, 7 young students, including myself, plus one friend that was cast as the actor outside our college, took on their first music video. But without being able to look at the original.

We had only 1 week to prepare locations, props for the scenery and brainstorm ideas before filming everything within a single day.

I’ll never forget getting home from filming from the morning till early noon and sitting behind my laptop until 5:00 AM to finish editing the video clip. I was so tired that I was unable to attend the viewing the next morning.

Our final project for year 1.

Together with 5 other guys in our team and 4 amazing friends that took on the roles of actors outside of our college, we were able to put this short action comedy film together.

We all had zero experience making films, especially when it came to the production side — things like shot compositing, transitioning from one scene to another and other things that contributed to creating the cohesive end result that became the film we know today. This was everyone’s first chance to show what they were able to pull off.
